title: Santa Totem Full Body
description: Santa Totem Full Body is a festive resource pack that fully redesigns the Totem of Undying into a Santa-themed model. Clean, detailed, and optimized for modern Minecraft versions.
body: Santa Totem Full Body is a resource pack that fully transforms the Totem of Undying into a detailed Santa design. It features a complete festive makeover while keeping a clean vanilla-friendly style. Lightweight, polished, and optimized for modern Minecraft versions.
